description: List the running scene Controls with rect, type and text. Call before simulate_input click_element to find names and paths. Needs a runtime session. visibleOnly (default true) drops hidden Controls and ones clipped out of view. filter narrows by class; root limits the list to one Control and its descendants. Returns: projectPath, elements[] with path/type/rect/visible/onScreen (visibleRect if clipped), optional text/disabled/tooltip. Errors on a non-Control filter or an unknown root.

filter.description: Filter by native Control class name (e.g. "Button", "Label", "LineEdit"); subclasses match. A class Control inherits from (CanvasItem, Node) lists every Control. Any other name, including a script class_name, is an error.

root.description: List only this Control and its descendants. Same lookup as simulate_input click_element: absolute path, relative path or node name (BFS matched). Visibility and clipping by ancestors above it still apply. An unknown name, or a node that is not a Control, is an error.

visibleOnly.description: Only return Controls that are visible in the tree and have area on screen, not clipped away by a ScrollContainer, a clip_contents ancestor or the viewport (default: true). Set false to include the rest.

name: get_ui_elements

onScreen.description: Whether any of the rect is reachable on screen after every clipping ancestor and the viewport. A Control with no area counts when its point is inside.

visibleRect.description: The part of rect that is on screen, present only when onScreen is true and the rect is clipped.
